payout_proof.reading: the vault ledger, the claimable bucket and the chain account balance of the contract agree, so the claim rail really moved native value out of the custody account; studionet eth_getBalance for externally owned accounts lagged during the run, so per wallet deltas are not claimed here

cross_contract_proof.reading: the syndicate really moved native capital into the live ProphetGrid via a value carrying cross contract call, the linked contract records the syndicate contract address as a real market making position holder (see grid_trader_portfolio), and reconcile read that live book back and booked the proceeds, so the routed capital is deployed and reconciled, not just stored

onchain_state.principle: The two answers must agree exactly on all seven fields, no tolerance. routing_band must be identical and one of HIGH_CONVICTION_DEPLOYMENT, BALANCED_HEDGE_ALLOCATION, DEFENSIVE_COLLATERAL_BUFFER, CORRELATION_FREEZE_WITHDRAWAL. The two quantized prints must be identical integers on the 250 bps grid inside 0 to 10000. The four derived integers must be identical. A missing field, an off grid print, or a band that disagrees with its own tail risk print is not equivalent.

verification_method: every transaction was waited to a terminal status over the studionet RPC and its consensus data (status, result, leader execution result and validator votes) recorded; the explorer UI was not queryable at run time (HTTP 503 DEPLOYMENT_PAUSED), so no explorer claim is made
